name: ASTRA MILITARUM: KASRKIN
description:
The Kasrkin are the elite of the elite among the lauded regiments of Cadia. These special operatives are trusted with more potent weaponry – such as high-powered hot-shot lasguns – and are equipped with thicker carapace armour to protect them in the most dangerous battles.

Elite Soldiers of Cadia

This multipart plastic kit builds a squad of 10 Kasrkin, Cadia's elite shock assault troops, for your Astra Militarum armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Armed with additional special weapons and better armour than most, they are an excellent unit for reliably sending into the thickest fighting.

Muster Your Specialists

This highly customisable kit builds a unit of exceptional soldiers with loads of optional weapons, poses, and head options to customise your miniatures. The individual troopers can be armed as follows.

– 1 Kasrkin Sergeant armed with a bolt pistol, plasma pistol, or hot-shot laspistol in the left hand, and a pointing arm, power sword, or chainsword on the right, as well as a unique head. This miniature can alternatively be built as a trooper with a hot-shot lasgun, or a gunner with a plasma gun
– 1 Kasrkin trooper armed with a hot-shot lasgun in one of two different poses, or a flamer
– 1 Kasrkin trooper armed with a hot-shot lasgun, a meltagun, or a melta mine and a hot-shot laspistol
– 1 Kasrkin trooper armed with a hot-shot lasgun in one of two poses, or a plasma gun
– 1 Kasrkin trooper armed with a hot-shot lasgun, a hot-shot marksman rifle, or a grenade launcher
– 1 Kasrkin trooper armed with a hot-shot lasgun, an alternative pose with a vox-caster, or a plasma gun
– 1 Kasrkin trooper armed with a hot-shot lasgun, or a hot-shot volley gun
– 2 Kasrkin troopers, each armed with a hot-shot lasgun or a plasma gun
– 1 Kasrkin trooper armed with a hot-shot lasgun, or a grenade launcher

Contents:
– 166 plastic components
– 10 Citadel 28.5mm Round Bases
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Cadian Transfer Sheet

The Cadian Transfer Sheet features 597 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols for regiments from Cadia, as well as logos, numerals, and markings to decorate your miniatures.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
